correctness.rationale: Exact coordinate minimization in energy coordinates z=H^(1/2)(x−x*) removes the projection along a unit direction u_i, so the sharp worst-direction expectation per expected work is λ_min(U diag(q) Uᵀ), with U=[u₁,u₂] invertible and cᵀq=1. Flip the second column if needed so UᵀU has positive off-diagonal ρ. For a lower bound g on that eigenvalue, congruence gives diag(q)−g(UᵀU)^(−1) positive semidefinite. Writing a_i=q_i−g/(1−ρ²), the two-dimensional condition is a_i≥0 and a₁a₂≥[gρ/(1−ρ²)]². Weighted AM–GM gives 1≥g(c₁+c₂+2ρ√(c₁c₂))/(1−ρ²). Equality is feasible and unique, including ρ=0 where both a_i vanish; for ρ>0 both the determinant bound and c₁a₁=c₂a₂ bind. Mapping back via p=q₁/(q₁+q₂) gives the claimed probabilities, allocation limits and interior support. The fair value is (1−ρ)/(c₁+c₂); the ratio is ≤1+ρ<2, with sharp supremum two by taking ρ→1 and c₁/c₂→∞. The proof's strict intermediate bound by 1+ρ is non-strict at ρ=0, but the finding's strict bound by two and all equality cases are correct. The stated example gives 3/10, 4/85, and 20/17. The verification package was inspected without executing the uploaded program. No claim about asymptotic, wall-clock, or stochastic work-normalized progress follows.

evidence: The 2018 Automatica problem fixes the trace of a diagonal perturbation to an essentially nonnegative matrix and allows designable entries. For an irreducible matrix Thm. 1 forces equal positive products of left and right dominant eigenvector coordinates on the designable entries; Lemma 1 gives the constructive line-sum rule.

The distinct prior coordinate-sampling and Kaczmarz records concern unpriced or equal-priced masks, complexity bounds, or a long-run annealed logarithmic objective; those are not the reason for rejection.
broader_coverage.reasoning: For ρ>0, A is a symmetric irreducible Metzler matrix and both diagonals are free, so the equal-product condition makes the positive Perron vector proportional to the all-ones vector. Thus the published optimization equalizes row sums. Trace T of D corresponds to the published perturbation −D of trace −T. For ρ=0 the same expression follows from the trivial diagonal case by balancing the two entries.

evidence: At fixed tr D=T, Thm. 1/Lemma 1 for A−D give (A−D)1=μ1 and D_ii=(A1)_i−μ, hence μ=(1ᵀA1−T)/2. This is the minimized largest eigenvalue (a fixed-trace minimizer exists by coercivity of the largest diagonal lower bound). PSD majorization is feasible exactly when this optimum is nonpositive. Thus T*=1ᵀA1 and D*=diag(A1).
Consequently g*=1/T*=(1−ρ²)/(c₁+c₂+2ρ√(c₁c₂)) and q_i*=D*_ii/(c_iT*); normalization gives the claimed unique p*. At ρ=0 the unique majorant of minimum trace is A itself.

The twofold sharp comparison follows immediately by evaluating the fair rule and taking the stated limits. The exact one-step quotient, not the neighboring annealed objective, is the quantity covered.

evidence: Putting v_i=c_iq_i makes v a probability vector, and using regressors u_i/√c_i turns the problem into two-support E-optimal design.

Equivalently, set A=(1−ρ²)^(−1)[[c₁,ρ√(c₁c₂)],[ρ√(c₁c₂),c₂]], the cost-scaled inverse Gram up to a diagonal sign conjugation. Congruence is exact: λ_min(U diag(q) Uᵀ)≥g iff diag(v)≥gA in the PSD order.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: For g>0, D=diag(v)/g satisfies D≥A with tr D=1/g, and conversely every feasible D in this diagonal majorization yields v by dividing by its trace. A is positive definite, so D automatically has positive diagonal; there is no extra positivity constraint lost. Optimizing the one-step quotient is identical to minimizing the trace of a diagonal PSD majorant of A.

originality.rationale: After cost rescaling and inversion of the two-direction Gram matrix, this is exactly the symmetric full-diagonal case of published fixed-trace dominant-eigenvalue minimization (Abad Torres and Roy, Automatica 89, 2018, Thm. 1 and Lemma 1). The known optimum inserted into the inverse reparameterization gives the whole allocation law and sharp value. The fair-sampling comparison and limiting cases are elementary consequences. No independent coverage was needed from the inaccessible statistics papers to decide this issue.
residual_risks: The earliest historical instance of a corresponding regression-design result is not determined. The originality failure is based on a verified mathematical implication from the 2018 full-text result, not on an inaccessible source or source-ranking inference.

value.rationale: The work-aware comparison is a sensible benchmark and may be useful as an application of known spectral allocation. As a standalone new finding, the main optimizer and value are the full-diagonal substitution into an existing stronger solution, and the equality cases, square-root limit and twofold gap follow by elementary algebra of that same substitution. No separately unresolved performance theorem or structural statement survives, and no substantive bounded repair was established.
